card.name: Word after Clinically in interaction headings
card.fires_on: Mainly the word Important or Significant right after "Clinically" in section 7 headings such as "Drugs Having Clinically Important Interactions with". Also fires on a few linking words or commas inside drug interaction sentences.

modes.label: Interaction heading adjective
modes.description: The word Important or Significant following Clinically in a drugs-with-or-without-interactions heading.

modes.label: Linking word in interaction sentence
modes.description: An "and" or comma partway through a sentence about co-administration or risk in a drug interaction section.
modes.example: in healthy subjects<< and>> in transplant patients receiving MMF has been
